## Foods & dishes
[[RecipeDB2]] ≈80 (v1); [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 46; [[WorldCuisines]] 15 dishes (1 Cambodia-only); [[FmLAMA]] 12.

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT; [[ASEAN Food Composition Database]] (candidate, priority 2) is the regional fallback.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
[[CMAUP]] 210 plants; [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 96 records; [[NPASS]] 4 pairs; [[KNApSAcK Family]] flag page not scraped. Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No Khmer-language data, no FCT, no traditional-medicine source.
